subject: MAP proposal + Azure private offer – pilot → commit ladder
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Emily Sanders <emily.sanders@bluewave.com>
Cc: Mark Cho <mark.cho@bluewave.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP proposal + Azure private offer – pilot → commit ladder

Hi Emily / Mark,

Thanks again for the time today. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) and the draft Azure private offer we discussed. The goal is to align on a short evaluation (pilot) followed by a ramped commit with milestone-linked pricing steps so BlueWave can get production SLA and predictable unit economics. High-level summary below: 

- Pilot: 4-week technical + business validation (May 2 – May 30) — limited to 200k tokens/month. No volume discount for pilot.
- Ramp / Commit ladder:
  • Stage 1 (post-pilot): 250k USD annual commit → 10% seat/usage discount, 30-day onboarding credit applied after signed PO.
  • Stage 2: 500k USD annual commit → 20% discount, includes 1-week priority onboarding.
  • Accelerator trigger: if commit reaches 1M USD, pricing steps and a reserved capacity SLA are added.

Ask: please review the MAP (BlueWave_MAP_v1.xlsx) and the private offer draft. If the milestones look reasonable, can you confirm target PO date to secure the Azure private offer? We need to submit the private offer request by the end of May to meet a June production target (Azure marketplace publishing lead time is ~2–3 weeks).

Attachments: BlueWave_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP), Azure_Private_Offer_Draft.pdf (draft private offer terms)

Next steps if you approve:
- We’ll move the draft into HubSpot and generate a DocuSign envelope for the private offer and PO.
- Laura and Vivek will lock in the exact discount ladder and onboarding credits.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Emily Sanders <emily.sanders@bluewave.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Cho <mark.cho@bluewave.com>
Date: 2027-04-16T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP proposal + Azure private offer – pilot → commit ladder

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear plan. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we lock:

1) Pilot length: Can we extend the pilot to 6 weeks? Our data platform team needs the extra validation window (May 2 – Jun 13).
2) Pricing triggers: We like the staged discounts but want the 250k commit to be a quarterly-recognized billing trigger (i.e., not annual up-front). Can you outline how the discount will be applied if we adopt a quarterly billing cadence?
3) Onboarding credit: The $25k onboarding credit is helpful — will that apply as a credit on the first invoice after PO?

If those items look OK, we’re comfortable committing to a pilot start on May 2 and aiming to sign a PO in early May so that private-offer publishing can happen mid-May. That puts production readiness in June, which is our goal.

Emily
Emily Sanders
Head of AI Platforms | BlueWave Retail
emily.sanders@bluewave.com | +1 (213) 555-9876

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-16T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP proposal + Azure private offer – pricing cadence question from BlueWave

Laura / Vivek — forwarding Emily’s reply. Key asks: 6-week pilot, want quarterly-recognized trigger for the 250k band, confirm onboarding credit timing (credit on first invoice post-PO).

Can you confirm:
- Do we need to change the private offer to allow quarterly-recognized commits? Azure private offers generally prefer annual commit amounts in the offer, but we can capture quarterly billing in the SOW/PO and keep the private-offer committed amount as an annualized number for marketplace purposes.
- Confirm exact discount ladder and whether we’ll attach the $25k onboarding credit as a one-time invoice credit.

Attaching pricing_ladder_v2.xlsx with a proposed alternative that maps quarterly billing to the same effective discount (e.g., 62.5k/quarter counts toward 250k band). Also note: Marketplace ops told me there’s a ~10 business day turnaround once publisher submits the private offer request. If BlueWave wants to start May 2, we need the signed PO by May 6 to be safe — otherwise we’ll risk slipping the private-offer publishing window.

Thanks — Soojin

Attachment: pricing_ladder_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-16T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP proposal + Azure private offer – pricing cadence question from BlueWave

Thanks — quick thoughts:

- Discount ladder (approved, subject to legal sign-off):
  • Pilot (6-week): no discount, usage capped as agreed.
  • Post-pilot Stage 1: 250k USD annualized commit (we’ll accept quarterly billing; 62.5k/quarter will count as the equivalent for triggering the 10% discount).
  • Stage 2: 500k USD annualized commit → 20% discount.
  • Accelerator: 1M+ commit → 30% and reserved capacity SLA.

- Onboarding credit: one-time $25k credit applied to the first invoice after PO execution (yes). We’ll add language that the credit applies only after delivery of customer success onboarding milestones.
- Marketplace mechanics: we should keep the private-offer amount annualized for Azure but capture the quarterly billing cadence in the SOW/PO and in the HubSpot deal record. That will keep Azure’s publisher flow clean.

Also recommend a one-off 30-day trial credit (token credit) for the pilot environment to reduce friction. I’ll let Legal take a quick look at the private-offer draft (Laura to loop legal).

Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Emily Sanders <emily.sanders@bluewave.com>
Cc: Mark Cho <mark.cho@bluewave.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-17T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Updated MAP & private offer link — request: confirm PO date to hit May publishing window

Emily / Mark,

Thanks for the quick feedback. We updated the MAP to reflect a 6-week pilot and the quarterly-billing mapping for the 250k band. The onboarding credit timing was clarified to apply to the first invoice after the PO and after onboarding milestones.

I’ve attached MAP_v2.xlsx and included the HubSpot and DocuSign links below so you can review the exact language for the private offer and sign when ready:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567
- Private offer (preview): https://portal.azure.com/private-offers/publisher/offer/abcd-efgh
- DocuSign (private-offer + SOW): https://www.docusign.net/Signing/?s=abcdef

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 18KB)

As a reminder, if the goal is production in June, we need an approved PO no later than May 10 to submit the private offer in time for mid-May publishing. Ask: can BlueWave confirm a PO target date? If you want, Vivek can join one quick alignment call with your data platform team early next week.

Thanks — Soojin

From: Emily Sanders <emily.sanders@bluewave.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Cho <mark.cho@bluewave.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-22T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Updated MAP & private offer link — request: confirm PO date to hit May publishing window

Hi Soojin — confirmed, this looks good. Two small edits we’ll ask legal to change in the SOW wording (one phrasing tweak around data retention, one around SLA response times); those won’t affect the commercial bands.

We’ll:
- Start the 6-week pilot on May 2.
- Target PO submission by May 10 (we’ll aim earlier if legal clears the SOW faster).
- Mark expects to sign DocuSign the private offer once we finalize the minor SOW edits; we’ll notify you the moment it’s signed so you can submit the Marketplace request.

Final ask: please include the pilot token-credit line item in the MAP_v2 so our procurement can see it on the PO.

Thanks — excited to get started.

Emily
